subject: Request: Extend attendee trial credits after workshop postponement
messages:
From: Nicole Zhang <nicole@cloudledger.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudLedger Events <events@cloudledger.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar — postponement and attendee trial top-up request

Hi Marcus,

Sorry for the late notice — our keynote had to move last-minute and we postponed the June 24th workshop to July 8th. We still want to offer attendees a small compensation for the inconvenience and to keep momentum.

Quick ask: could Redwood extend the expiration window on the attendee trial credits from 30 days to 60 days for this cohort and add an additional 50 credit units per registrant (roughly 50k tokens) for those who attended the live session after the reschedule? I attached the registrant list (cloudledger_registrants_0621.csv).

We understand this is a deviation from the standard promo policy — happy to accept a short addendum or an acknowledgment email. If we need to limit it to a subset (paid vs free registrants) we can provide that segmentation.

Appreciate any flexibility — this was an exceptional situation on our end.

Thanks,
Nicole Zhang
Head of Events, CloudLedger
nicole@cloudledger.ai

[attachment: cloudledger_registrants_0621.csv]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Webinar — postponement and attendee trial top-up request

Team — forwarding CloudLedger's ask below. TL;DR: they want the trial redemption window extended (30 -> 60 days) and an extra 50 credit units per attendee (estimate ~50k tokens) for the rescheduled cohort. Registrant list attached.

Action items I need:
- Marissa: can finance/partner-credits approve a 50-unit top-up per attendee for ~420 registrants? If not full, propose a cap we can do. Please confirm how we reconcile unused credits after 90 days.
- Vanessa: if approved, will you provision a promo batch and set expiry to 60 days from issuance? Please include per-code limits and redemption instructions.
- Priyom: if we need to segment (paid vs free), can you flag which registrants should be prioritized?

We should avoid creating open-ended coupons — prefer single-use per email codes. If needed, I can push a short addendum to Nicole acknowledging the exception.

Thanks — Marcus

"Webinar — postponement and attendee trial top-up request" from Nicole Zhang <nicole@cloudledger.ai>

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Webinar — postponement and attendee trial top-up request

Marcus — I reviewed the numbers. We can approve a 40-credit top-up per verified attendee (approx 420 emails on that list) as a one-off goodwill gesture. Financial note: cap total exposure at 20k credits. Any unused credits will auto-expire after 90 days and be returned to the promo pool; we'll reconcile on July 31.

Requirements:
- Single-use per-email codes only.
- Max per-code redemption = 40 credits.
- Expiration = 60 days from issuance.

I've attached the promo_batch we'll push (promo_batch_CLOUDLEDGER_06-21.csv) — Vanessa, please use this file and set the code rules above. Priyom, if you can confirm which rows are paid registrants, mark them in the CSV with PAID in column G; otherwise we'll apply uniformly.

If CloudLedger insists on 50 credits, we can split 50% externally-funded and 50% Redwood-funded; we'd need a PO or cost-share note.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Ops
[attachment: promo_batch_CLOUDLEDGER_06-21.csv]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Nicole Zhang <nicole@cloudledger.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Webinar — postponement and attendee trial top-up request

Nicole — quick update and confirmation:

Good news — Redwood can approve a one-time 40-credit top-up per verified attendee from your registrant list, with the following guardrails:
- Codes will be single-use and bound to the attendee email.
- Each code equals 40 trial credits (≈40k tokens).
- Expiration window extended to 60 days from issuance.
- Unused credits auto-expire and we'll reconcile on July 31; any consumption beyond the cap will be billed to CloudLedger if we agree to a cost-share.

Vanessa has the promo batch and will push codes by EOD tomorrow; I'll send a confirmation email with a redeem_instructions.txt that you can share with attendees. If you prefer 50 credits, we can do a 50/50 cost split but will need a short PO or formal acknowledgement from CloudLedger.

Thanks for flagging early — sorry again about the disruption. We want the attendees to have a smooth try-before-you-buy experience.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Partner Sales 
Redwood Inference
